pages.title: Wild Water Buffalo
pages.text: The wild water buffalo ($(o)Bubalus arnee$()) is a large bovine native to South and Southeast Asia, where it lives in wet grasslands, swamps and river valleys.$(br2)It has the widest horn span of any living bovid, its backward-sweeping horns spreading up to two metres.$(br2)Wild water buffalo spend much of the day wallowing in mud and water. The species is endangered, with only a few thousand left in the wild.
